overview: The committee reviewed the first draft of the Boston Avenue corridor rezoning, adjusting building height incentives and usage rules for the proposed sub-districts. The committee amended the proposal to prohibit specific car-oriented uses and referred the draft to a joint meeting with the Community Development Board.

items.title: Presentation of Boston Avenue Rezoning Draft
items.summary: Innes Land Strategy Group presented a draft rezoning plan for the Boston Avenue corridor, introducing three sub-districts categorized by development intensity.

items.title: Sub-district Naming and Use Standards
items.summary: Adopted the naming convention of BA1, BA2, and BA3 for the sub-districts and debated the inclusion of co-housing and student housing types.

items.title: Amendment to Prohibit Drive-Throughs and Gas Stations
items.summary: Approved an amendment to the draft proposal to list drive-through eating establishments and gas stations as prohibited uses in all three sub-districts.

items.title: Dimensional Standards and Height Incentives
items.summary: Discussed the height incentive structure and adjusted the proposed limits to 3+1 stories for BA1, 4+3 for BA2, and 6+2 for BA3.

items.title: Environmental Standards and Green Score
items.summary: Reviewed the increased green score requirement of 25 points, designed to incentivize larger trees and better stormwater management than previous zoning.

items.title: Parking Reductions and Sidewalk Requirements
items.summary: Discussed sidewalk widening requirements and parking minimum reductions based on proximity to the Green Line extension.

items.title: Tufts University Institutional Zoning
items.summary: Evaluated preliminary concepts for a separate institutional zone for the Tufts campus, including sub-areas for campus core and neighborhood-facing edges.

items.title: Public Comment
items.summary: Residents expressed concerns regarding building heights, the definition of dormitories versus apartments, and the need for site plan reviews for smaller projects.

items.title: Referral to Regular Meeting
items.summary: Referred the amended rezoning proposal to the regular City Council meeting and scheduled it for joint review with the Community Development Board.
